Name: Ascii
Description: Return the ASCII character code of the first character of a string.

Arguments.name: s1
Arguments.description: Any expression evaluating to a string

Returns: The character code of the first character of the string
Exceptions: If the argument is not a string, an error value is returned

Example.description: [Returns 68, the ASCII character code for D]
[Returns 80, the ASCII character code for the first letter of the string]
